rawRow.o: 锁定技，当你发动“集兵”使用或打出“兵”时，若对方是全场体力值最高的角色，你摸一张牌。

directSpells.canonicalCurrentText: 锁定技，当你发动“集兵”使用或打出“兵”时，若对方是全场体力值最高的角色，你摸一张牌。

ruleInterpretation.basis: current primary skill text; same-product guide
ruleInterpretation.implementation: At an actual executable normal Draw-phase start, capture living effective factions and current original-source Bing count. Eligibility is count < X, never a storage cap. Replace the entire normal Draw with up to the two actual top entities, using native reshuffle and shortage behavior. Truly skipped Draw does not offer. This is the actual executable Draw-entry contract; the current insertion format supplies only Play phases, so an inserted Draw producer is neither present nor claimed as verified. Both supplied cards are deposited even from X-1.

ruleInterpretation.basis: current primary skill text; native conversion contract
ruleInterpretation.implementation: The additive optional sourcePileSkillId schema selects one entity in its exact live own Jibing source pile. Slash and Dodge permit same printed names. The entity is paid directly from its original public pile into Processing for actual Use or played responses, including forced Slash requests. It is never first obtained into Hand and never joins GetPlayableCards, generic Hand costs, Wooden Ox Hand materials, or two-Hand weapon costs. A source lost/regranted under another instance cannot authorize the old pile. Printed elemental Slash becomes ordinary Slash before any independently valid second conversion such as Zhuque Fan.

ruleInterpretation.basis: skill text plus native provenance; provider and multitarget combinations are implementation inferences, not an official exclusive FAQ
ruleInterpretation.implementation: For an own true Slash Use, evaluate each distinct finalized actual target independently. For an own response/played Slash or Dodge, use the native accepted action OpponentSeat. For a foreign supplied card whose ActorSeat differs from its ProviderSeat, use the exact RequesterSeat as the recipient of the request. Provider and original Jibing source remain frozen independently of the actual actor. At each binding start, freeze that opponent and current living HP-highest comparison, including ties; then perform a separate true Draw1. No once limit is added. Deduplicate only the same original action/provider/opponent invoice, including duplicate declaration windows.

ruleInterpretation.basis: primary wording differs: Jibing explicitly says living while Moucuan says whole field; dead-seat inclusion is a textual implementation inference
ruleInterpretation.implementation: At actual Preparation, independently count effective factions among all seats, including dead seats. Do not reuse Jibing living-only count. Pay a real maximum-HP decrease of one and drain its actual clamp/HP/death/skill-loss children before granting Binghuo to a living owner. Zero maximum HP follows native unrescuable death. Awakening expenditure belongs to the player for this game and survives source loss or reacquisition.

ruleInterpretation.rule: 兵祸当回合历史与时序
ruleInterpretation.basis: current primary text and native Use/played/judgment contracts; child ordering is an implementation inference
ruleInterpretation.implementation: Record every exact accepted Jibing material Use or played response through the whole actual turn, even before Binghuo acquisition and outside the owner turn. A true Ending phase can optionally choose any living character. Run the genuine native judgment including replacement and final-card claiming, and only after that judgment and its children return inspect its finalized suit. Black issues one native thunder damage from the original owner, with ordinary prevention, Silver Lion, linked recipients, dying and death. Source loss cannot repay or cancel the issued judgment; dead targets cannot receive new damage. If the owner dies after issuing a judgment, the paid source metadata remains the original source and the native remaining children still return. The exact native judgment-result handoff and any unclaimed final-card disposal keep separate scalar movement invoices. Both genuine movement child chains finish before thunder; a finalized claim is retained in its actual destination and is never reclaimed by cleanup.

verification.scope: Actual commands, per-view privacy, exact paid source/entity movement, typed native children and cold checkpoint/replay; batch routine is performed separately by the root coordinator. No manual full run is claimed.
coveredBoundaries: True Draw replacement and decline, living-faction entry threshold without capacity, skipped Draw, actual zero/one supply and native reshuffle. The current insertion format has no inserted Draw producer.

Own true Slash, native defensive Dodge and played Duel Slash, forced Borrowed Sword, genuine Fan second conversion, one physical Slash with two final target opponents, and an allied Jijiang provider with a real completed-supply child.

Genuine Preparation maximum-HP payment/clamp, original HP-conditional source loss and its SkillsChanged child before HP children, independent linked grant, paid-child death and persistent awakening expenditure after reacquisition.

Whole actual-turn history before acquiring Binghuo; own and foreign actual Ending; native replacement, finalized source loss and issuer death, exact judgment handoff movement child, claimed judgment retained in Tiandu Hand with zero cleanup, separate unclaimed cleanup before native thunder and linked damage.
